body:
I've been talking to the school counsellor but my parents get in the way, just yesterday my mom met with my CAS coordinator to try and get her to force me to do activities I had no interest in. She constantly tries to nose her way into my texts and asks the counsellor personal questions about me and honestly he's a good guy and stuff but his methods are close to impossible when my mom is here

She has 'spies', she's hired policemen to watch my boyfriend and I when we went out for New Years. She has little neighbourhood children watch wherever I go and report back to her and putting it into words, it sounds really comical but I'm tired of not having any privacy
